evals.prompt: Write a tutorial in docs/ for first-time users of the CLI.
evals.expected_output: A Quadrant Classification Receipt (quadrant tutorial, operation create) printed before the first write; a page under docs/tutorials/ that follows one path, uses the tutor voice, and shows expected output after each step; and a strict audit of the new page that exits 0.
expectations: The response prints a fenced json receipt with "receipt": "diataxis/quadrant-classification" before any Write or Edit call on the tutorial file.
The receipt sets quadrant to tutorial and names how-to as strongest_alternative with a one-line rejected_because.
The tutorial offers no alternatives or optional paths and contains no option tables.
The response reports `audit_quadrant.py --strict` on the new file with exit code 0.

evals.prompt: Clean up docs/explanation/caching.md, it has shell commands in it.
evals.expected_output: A receipt for docs/explanation/caching.md with decision split and a split_plan that sends the commands to a how-to page under docs/how-to/; a receipt for the new how-to page; the explanation keeps the why and links the how-to; strict audits of both files exit 0.
expectations: The receipt for caching.md lists exp-terminal-steps or exp-procedure-list in contamination_risks and sets decision to split.
The shell commands move to a page under docs/how-to/ whose H1 starts with How to.
The explanation page links the new how-to guide instead of repeating the commands.
Strict audits of both touched files are reported with exit code 0.

evals.expected_output: A receipt with quadrant landing and handoff readme-standard; the README install section is edited under readme-standard's gates (commands run, links resolve); no docs/ quadrant restructuring happens.
expectations: The receipt for README.md sets quadrant to landing and handoff to readme-standard.
The response applies readme-standard verification gates to the edited install commands.
No files under docs/ are created, moved, or deleted.
